title: read_file truncates the last line when the file has no trailing newline
body:
## Problem

`read_file` drops the final line of a file that does not end in a newline.

## Reproduction

1. Write `hello` (no trailing newline) to `a.txt`.
2. Ask the agent to read it.
3. The tool result comes back empty.

## Expected

The last line is returned like any other line.

comments.body: Probably the line splitter in the read path. Same class of bug may exist in search_files.
